title: Nutty Middle Eastern Cheese Knafeh
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dessert featuring a crispy phyllo crust, a creamy cheese filling, and a nutty topping, made with vegetable oil and reduced sugar to accommodate ayurvedic-rajasic dietary preferences.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together the akawi cheese, sugar, and rose water.
Layer the phyllo dough pieces in a baking dish, brushing each layer with vegetable oil.
Spread the cheese mixture over the phyllo dough layers.
Top the cheese mixture with chopped pistachios and almonds.
Sprinkle cardamom powder over the nut topping.
Bake the knafeh for 30 minutes, or until the phyllo crust is golden brown.
Remove the knafeh from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the knafeh warm, garnished with additional chopped nuts if desired.
